findings.title: 64-Day Certificate Lifetimes Coming Feb 2027
findings.summary_md: Let's Encrypt announced on October 7, 2026 that starting February 10, 2027 all newly issued or renewed certificates will default to 64-day lifetimes, with staging tests beginning October 14, 2026. The final 90-day certificates are expected to expire May 11, 2027, and authorization reuse will shrink from 30 to 10 days ahead of a 2028 45-day default and a 2029 seven-hour reuse limit.

findings.title: Decreasing Certificate Lifetimes to 45 Days
findings.summary_md: In a December 2025 post, Let's Encrypt laid out the industry-wide timeline: current 90-day certificates will be cut in half to 45 days by 2028 per CA/Browser Forum Baseline Requirements. The change aims to limit compromise scope and improve revocation efficiency, with all publicly trusted CAs making similar adjustments.
